property.name: fs.defaultFS
property.description: Port 8020, not the 9000 seen in many tutorials. 8020 is Hadoop's own default NameNode RPC port, and the kit's HSDataCheck class hardcodes hdfs://127.0.0.1:8020 (TPCx-HS-SRC-MR2/HSDataCheck.java:34). Matching it makes the kit's verification tool work without patching kit source.

property.name: hadoop.tmp.dir
property.description: Kept under ~/project with the rest of the project; no root on this VM.
